result.summary: This PR unifies how the GUI and command-line tools (bitcoin-cli, bitcoind, bitcoin-wallet) determine the default data directory. It changes the GUI to store a custom datadir choice as a symlink or marker file at the default datadir location instead of in a Qt-only settings key, refactors ArgsManager's config-file and datadir resolution logic to support this, and makes bitcoin-wallet load the config file like other tools. It is a draft built on the merged #27302 and has been open since April 2023 without reaching a mergeable state.
result.problem: Users who pick a non-default data directory in the GUI intro screen currently get inconsistent behavior from CLI tools, which ignore that choice: bitcoin-cli and bitcoin-wallet show errors, and bitcoind silently uses a different datadir, downloading blocks and loading wallets in the wrong place. This affects any user who runs both the GUI and CLI tools against the same node.

result.card: This draft PR unifies the default data directory used by the Bitcoin Core GUI and CLI tools, fixing a real bug where a GUI-selected datadir is ignored by bitcoin-cli, bitcoind, and bitcoin-wallet, causing wallets and blocks to end up in the wrong place. It refactors core ArgsManager config-file and datadir resolution logic and makes bitcoin-wallet load the config file for the first time. Open since April 2023, it remains a draft with a confirmed unfixed Windows-specific bug (pinheadmz) and the author stating in 2024 that the work is not finished and unlikely to resume soon. A 2025 rebase did not add substantive progress. Depends on the already-merged #27302; no open PRs depend on it.
